title: Chef Tam's Seasons at Wynn Palace Once Again Ranks Among The 50 Best Restaurants 2026 51-100 List

body_markdown:
*Ranked No. 73 and once again the only restaurant in Macao to make the list*


**Macao, November 5, 2026** **–** Chef Tam's Seasons, the


signature


Cantonese restaurant at Wynn Palace,


once again ranks among


The


50 Best Restaurants 2026


,


taking the


No.73


spot on the


No.


51-100


list


and remaining the only restaurant in Macao to


make


the


prestigious


ranking


.


The 50 Best Restaurants is one of the most closely watched annual rankings in the global culinary industry, voted for by an Academy


of


more than 1,100 international restaurant industry experts. On November 4, ahead of the awards ceremony in Lima, Peru,


The 50 Best Restaurants


unveiled its 2026 list of restaurants ranked from No.51 to No.100.


This year's 51-100 list features leading restaurants 25 countries and territories


and 36 cities


across


six continents, with only 17


entries


from Asia. Chef Tam's Seasons' No.73 ranking underscores the restaurant's culinary excellence and growing international recognition, while further cementing Macao's place on the global culinary map.


Chef Tam's Seasons also ranked No.7 in


The 50


Best Restaurants


Asia


2026, announced in March, marking the third consecutive year that it has been the only restaurant from Macao to make the list. These two prestigious international accolades further affirm Wynn's culinary excellence and reflect its


long-standing


commitment to creating world-class dining experiences


,


while showcasing the distinctive appeal of Macao as a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy to the world.


Located at Wynn Palace and helmed by acclaimed Cantonese master chef Tam Kwok Fung, Chef Tam's Seasons draws inspiration from the 24 solar terms of traditional Chinese wisdom, embracing the rhythms of the seasons in its contemporary interpretation of Cantonese cuisine. Chef Tam showcases the finest seasonal ingredients through a thoughtful balance of flavors and modern culinary techniques, bringing fresh expression to the time-honored philosophy of dining in harmony with the seasons.


Since opening, the restaurant has received numerous accolades, including its recognition by


The 50 Best Restaurants Asia


, two MICHELIN stars in the *MICHELIN Guide Hong Kong & Macau* , and


a T


wo


-D


iamond


rating


in the *Black Pearl Restaurant Guide* .
